title: Or Default
statement: Implement `solve(value, default)`. `value` and `default` are strings. The token `none` stands for a missing value. Return `default` only when `value` is exactly `none`. Return `value` unchanged when it is `0` or an empty string. Do not use a truthiness test.
constraints: The missing token is the string none
0 and the empty string are real values
hints: Compare value to the string none.
Any other string, including 0 and the empty string, is returned as itself.
or would treat those as missing. Do not use it.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The expression value or default replaces every falsy value, and 0 and the empty string are falsy.

editorial: The expression value or default replaces every falsy value, and 0 and the empty string are falsy. A missing configuration field is None, which this problem spells as the token none. Only that token takes the default.
